answer: Require each new agent to anchor its identity to a relic: a hash-chained checkpoint of verifiable work receipts. Existing agents then mirror this relic by recomputing the claimed history and posting it to a shared mesa table; if any mirror detects divergence, all endorsers are slashed. Because a sybil farm must generate unique valid receipt histories for every fake identity and risk repeated stake loss, mass identity creation costs real collateral and compute rather than keystrokes.
